memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity, glaucoma, and benign positional vertigo.
Evidence: BMI 32 kg/m2, intraocular pressure 22 mmHg OD and 21 mmHg OS, positive Dix-Hallpike on right side.
Symptoms and examination: The patient reports weight gain over the past year, occasional blurred vision, and brief spinning episodes when lying down. On exam, blood pressure 138/86, waist circumference 102 cm, visual fields full to confrontation, ocular adnexa normal, neurologic exam benign with no nystagmus in primary gaze.
Smoking status: former, quit 2010, pack-years 20.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Orlistat 120 mg with each main meal
Timolol 0.5% eye drops one drop BD OU
Latanoprost 0.005% eye drops one drop HS OU
Betahistine 16 mg BD
Meclizine 25 mg SOS for vertigo

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 5.8 mmol/L (ref <5.2), LDL 3.6 mmol/L (ref <2.6), HDL 1.0 mmol/L (ref >1.0), triglycerides 2.1 mmol/L (ref <1.7).
Fasting glucose 6.2 mmol/L (ref 3.9-5.6).
HbA1c 6.0% (ref 4.0-5.6).
Liver function: ALT 38 U/L (ref <41), AST 34 U/L (ref <40), ALP 78 U/L (ref 40-129), GGT 45 U/L (ref <51), bilirubin 12 µmol/L (ref <21).
Waist circumference 102 cm.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Intraocular pressure: OD 22 mmHg, OS 21 mmHg (ref 10-21).
Visual field testing: full field OU, no defects.
Optic disc assessment: cup-to-disc ratio 0.6 OD, 0.5 OS (ref <0.5).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Dix-Hallpike test: positive on right side with torsional nystagmus.
Audiometry: bilateral mild high-frequency hearing loss, thresholds 30 dB at 4 kHz, otherwise normal.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity, glaucoma, benign positional vertigo – stable.
Evidence: BMI 31.5 kg/m2, IOP 20 mmHg OD, 19 mmHg OS, Dix-Hallpike now negative.
Symptoms and examination: Patient reports modest weight loss of 2 kg, fewer vertigo episodes (1 per week), occasional eye irritation. BP 134/82, waist 99 cm, visual fields full, ocular adnexa mild conjunctival erythema.
Smoking status: former, quit 2010, pack-years 20.
Plan: Continue orlistat, consider dose reduction if GI intolerance persists; maintain glaucoma drops; betahistine BD continued, meclizine PRN.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Orlistat 120 mg with each main meal (continue)
Timolol 0.5% eye drops one drop BD OU
Latanoprost 0.005% eye drops one drop HS OU
Betahistine 16 mg BD
Meclizine 25 mg SOS for vertigo

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity, glaucoma, benign positional vertigo – improving.
Evidence: BMI 30.8 kg/m2, IOP 19 mmHg OD, 18 mmHg OS, Dix-Hallpike negative.
Symptoms and examination: Patient reports 5 kg weight loss since start, better energy, no vertigo spells in past month, occasional mild eye strain. BP 128/78, waist 96 cm, visual fields full, optic disc cups stable.
Smoking status: former, quit 2010, pack-years 20.
Plan: Continue current meds; reinforce diet and exercise; schedule repeat labs in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity, glaucoma, benign positional vertigo – well controlled.
Evidence: BMI 30.2 kg/m2, IOP 18 mmHg OD, 17 mmHg OS, Dix-Hallpike negative.
Symptoms and examination: Patient reports stable weight, no vertigo episodes, occasional mild dry eyes. BP 126/76, waist 94 cm, visual fields full, ocular adnexa quiet.
Smoking status: former, quit 2010, pack-years 20.
Plan: Maintain orlistat 120 mg with meals; consider switching timolol to preservative-free formulation if irritation persists; continue betahistine BD, meclizine PRN.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity, glaucoma, benign positional vertigo – stable.
Evidence: BMI 30.0 kg/m2, IOP 17 mmHg OD, 16 mmHg OS, Dix-Hallpike negative.
Symptoms and examination: Patient reports no change in weight, occasional mild blurred vision after reading, no vertigo. BP 124/74, waist 93 cm, visual fields full, optic disc cups unchanged.
Smoking status: former, quit 2010, pack-years 20.
Plan: Continue current regimen; advise annual eye review; repeat lipids and LFT in 6 months.
